description: Source code for bcm4908img utility functions, including parsing, creating, extracting, and managing boot filesystem in BCM4908 firmware images.

methods.name: bcm4908img_info
methods.description: Prints information about a BCM4908 firmware image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create
methods.description: Creates a new BCM4908 firmware image with specified data and padding.

methods.name: bcm4908img_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified data segments from a BCM4908 firmware image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_open
methods.description: Opens a file or stdin for reading BCM4908 image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_close
methods.description: Closes the file pointer if not stdin.

methods.name: bcm4908img_parse
methods.description: Parses the BCM4908 image to find offsets, CRC, and tail.

methods.name: bcm4908img_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum for data buffer.

methods.name: bcm4908img_calc_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum of the image data.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create_append_file
methods.description: Appends file data to image and updates CRC.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create_append_zeros
methods.description: Appends zeros to image for padding.

methods.name: bcm4908img_create_align
methods.description: Pads image with zeros to align to specified boundary.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs_ls
methods.description: Lists files in the boot filesystem of the image.

methods.name: bcm4908img_bootfs_mv
methods.description: Renames a file in the boot filesystem.
